speech.heard: Philippines has 2.5 times the high-tech export share of the USA. We count products with high research and development intensity, like computers and pharmaceuticals. In the Philippines, 60.397% of factory exports are high-tech. Manufacturing giants sit lower. China has 26.2777% and the USA has 24.323%. In India, the share is 18.5724%. Others trail far behind. Nigeria has 2.7117% and Bhutan has 0.0107%. Where does your country land?
